headline: 2.32 Lakh: Gold prices revised by BAJUS
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association has set new prices for gold including VAT, effective from June 18, 2026.
details: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has announced new prices for gold including VAT. The price for one bhori (11.664 grams) of 22-carat gold has been set at 232,930 BDT.

headline: Luis Diaz dazzles as Colombia beat Uzbekistan 3-1 in World Cup opener
summary: Colombia marked their return to the World Cup with a dominant win at the Azteca Stadium, moving to the top of Group K.
details: Colombia secured a 3-1 victory over tournament debutants Uzbekistan in their Group K opening match at the Azteca Stadium on Wednesday.
Winger Luis Diaz was the standout performer, providing a brilliant assist for Daniel Munoz, who scored the opening goal in the 41st minute.
Uzbekistan briefly fought back to equalize on the hour mark when Abbosbek Fayzullaev headed in a rebound after a shot from Eldor Shomurodov was spilled.
Diaz quickly restored the lead five minutes later, slotting the ball home from the left of the area to make it 2-1.
Substitute Jaminton Campaz sealed the win with a header in stoppage time, ensuring a comfortable 3-1 result for the South Americans.
With Portugal and Democratic Republic of Congo drawing 1-1, Colombia now sits at the top of Group K.
Colombia will next face DR Congo in Guadalajara on Tuesday, while Uzbekistan is set to play Portugal in Houston.
caption:
Luis Diaz shines as Colombia makes a winning return to the World Cup stage!

Colombia secured a 3-1 victory over tournament debutants Uzbekistan in their Group K opening match at the Azteca Stadium on Wednesday.

Winger Luis Diaz was the standout performer, providing a brilliant assist for Daniel Munoz, who scored the opening goal in the 41st minute.

Uzbekistan briefly fought back to equalize on the hour mark when Abbosbek Fayzullaev headed in a rebound after a shot from Eldor Shomurodov was spilled.

Diaz quickly restored the lead five minutes later, slotting the ball home from the left of the area to make it 2-1.

Substitute Jaminton Campaz sealed the win with a header in stoppage time, ensuring a comfortable 3-1 result for the South Americans.

With Portugal and Democratic Republic of Congo drawing 1-1, Colombia now sits at the top of Group K.

Colombia will next face DR Congo in Guadalajara on Tuesday, while Uzbekistan is set to play Portugal in Houston.
